# NOIR Web

NOIR Web is an unofficial browser-based Android privacy audit. It connects to an Android device over WebUSB and reads device properties and the installed APK inventory entirely in the browser.

## Scope

- M0: WebUSB authorization, ADB authentication, device info, base APK inventory
- M1: permissions, endpoints, AXML, DEX, reports

## Privacy

All device data stays in the browser. There is no backend, telemetry or upload path.
